data.name: List Agents
data.description:
Returns a paginated list of Conversational AI agents available to your workspace (and optionally only those you own), including metadata such as name, tags, creation time, access info, last call time, and archived status.
Documentation: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-agents/api-reference/agents/list
Quick Start:
- Create an ElevenLabs API key and pass it as the xi-api-key header.
- Call GET {{baseUrl}}/v1/convai/agents.
- Use pageSize (default 30) and the returned nextCursor for pagination.
Parameters Explained:
- pageSize (optional, integer, default: 30, min: 1, max: 100): Max number of agents to return.
- search (optional, string): Search by agent name.
- archived (optional, boolean): Filter by archived status.
- showOnlyOwnedAgents (optional, boolean, default: false): If true, omits agents shared with you and returns only agents you own.
- sortDirection (optional, enum: asc | desc): Sort direction.
- sortBy (optional, enum: name | created_at): Field to sort by.
- cursor (optional, string): Cursor for the next page; use the nextCursor returned by a previous response.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 401 Unauthorized: Missing/invalid API key. Ensure xi-api-key is present and correct.
- 422 Unprocessable Entity: One or more query parameters are invalid (e.g., pageSize out of range, invalid enum values). Use allowed enum values and keep pageSize within 1–100.
Edge Cases:
- Pagination is cursor-based: when has_more is true, pass nextCursor into cursor to fetch the next page.
- nextCursor can be null when there is no next page.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Not specified on this page; follow workspace/API key limits enforced by ElevenLabs.
